symbols.name: cyclic convolution
symbols.meaning: The cyclic convolution of two vectors of equal length, whose indices wrap around modulo the length.
symbols.quote: The cyclic convolution of $u$ and $v$, written $u\ast v$, has entries

symbols.name: entry index
symbols.meaning: An index of a vector entry, an element of $\mathbb{Z}/s\mathbb{Z}$.
symbols.quote: For vectors $u$ and $v$ of length $s$, index the entries by $i,j,m \in \mathbb{Z}/s\mathbb{Z}$, that is, by $0,\dots,s-1$ with sums taken modulo $s$.

symbols.name: entry index
symbols.meaning: A second index of a vector entry, an element of $\mathbb{Z}/s\mathbb{Z}$.
symbols.quote: For vectors $u$ and $v$ of length $s$, index the entries by $i,j,m \in \mathbb{Z}/s\mathbb{Z}$, that is, by $0,\dots,s-1$ with sums taken modulo $s$.

symbols.name: output index
symbols.meaning: The index of an entry of the cyclic convolution, an element of $\mathbb{Z}/s\mathbb{Z}$.
symbols.quote: For vectors $u$ and $v$ of length $s$, index the entries by $i,j,m \in \mathbb{Z}/s\mathbb{Z}$, that is, by $0,\dots,s-1$ with sums taken modulo $s$.

symbols.name: entry count
symbols.meaning: The number of entries of an array indexed by the axes $s_1,\dots,s_d$, namely $s_1 s_2\cdots s_d$.
symbols.quote: Let $S=s_1s_2\cdots s_d$, the number of entries of such an array (so $S=s$ when $d=1$).

symbols.name: retained source permutation
symbols.meaning: The coordinate permutation of the source vectors that is kept in the formula and cancels across the convolution.
symbols.quote: Write $R$ for the retained source permutation, the $P_s$ of the resampling identity, with inverse $R^{-1}$.
